# Source files generated at build time by stock SQLite tools.
set(sqlite_generated_sources
  # Generated by the mkvdbeauxinlines.tcl script.
  memcompare.c
  serialget.c
  vdbeaux.c
  vdbecompare.c

  # Generated by the `mkkeywordhash` tool (compiled at build time).
  keywordhash.h

  # Generated by the mksqlite3h.tcl script from src/sqlite.h.in. This is
  # SQLite's public header. It is *not* checked in.
  sqlite3.h

  # Generated by the mkopcodec.tcl script.
  opcodes.c

  # Generated by the mkpragmatab.tcl script.
  pragma.h

  # Generated by the `lemon` tool (compiled at build time).
  parse.c
)

set(sqlite_extension_sources
  # The expert mode extension is used to analyze a collection of SQL statements
  # and suggest indexes that may improve query performance.
  ext/expert/sqlite3expert.c

  # Support for binding arrays in parameterized queries.
  # TODO(sqlite-upgrade): ext/misc/carray.c is now ./src/carray.c
  ext/misc/carray.c

  # Provides support for SQL completion (e.g. in REPLs).
  # TODO(sqlite-upgrade): This has Comdb2 changes but doesn't seem to be used?
  ext/misc/completion.c

  # Implements the `regexp()` function.
  ext/misc/regexp.c

  # Implements the `generate_series()` function.
  ext/misc/series.c
)

add_library(sqlite
  ${sqlite_generated_sources}
  ${sqlite_core_sources}
  ${sqlite_extension_sources}
  ${sqlite_comdb2_sources}
)
include(${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/sqlite/definitions.cmake)
add_definitions(${SQLITE_FLAGS})
target_compile_definitions(sqlite PRIVATE ${SQLITE_FLAGS})

if (${CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID} STREQUAL GNU OR ${CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID} STREQUAL Clang)
  set_source_files_properties(src/hash.c PROPERTIES COMPILE_FLAGS "-Wno-char-subscripts")
  set_source_files_properties(src/select.c PROPERTIES COMPILE_FLAGS "-Wno-unused-value")
  set_source_files_properties(src/build.c PROPERTIES COMPILE_FLAGS "-Wno-misleading-indentation")
endif()
if (${CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID} STREQUAL GNU)
  set_source_files_properties(parse.c PROPERTIES COMPILE_FLAGS "-Wno-trivial-auto-var-init")
  set_source_files_properties(src/trigger.c src/status.c PROPERTIES COMPILE_FLAGS "-Wno-unused-but-set-variable -Wno-unused-const-variable")
  # SQLite stores some token numbers in u8 fields (Expr.op, Window.eFrmType,
  # etc.). Since our grammar rules add tokens, make sure that we don't bump
  # SQLite's tokens out of range.
  target_compile_options(sqlite PRIVATE -Werror=overflow -Werror=switch-outside-range)
elseif(${CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID} STREQUAL Clang OR ${CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID} STREQUAL AppleClang)
  set_source_files_properties(src/trigger.c src/status.c PROPERTIES COMPILE_FLAGS "-Wno-unused-const-variable")
  # See the GNU branch above.
  target_compile_options(sqlite PRIVATE -Werror=constant-conversion)
endif()


set(module sqlite)
set(MODULE SQLITE)
configure_file(${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/mem/mem.h.in mem_sqlite.h @ONLY)
configure_file(src/parse.y parse.y COPYONLY)
configure_file(tool/lempar.c lempar.c COPYONLY)
configure_file(tool/mkopcodec.tcl mkopcodec.tcl COPYONLY)
configure_file(tool/mkopcodeh.tcl mkopcodeh.tcl COPYONLY)
configure_file(tool/mkvdbeauxinlines.tcl mkvdbeauxinlines.tcl COPYONLY)

file(READ ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/lua/default_consumer_v1.1.lua default_consumer)
string(REPLACE "\n" "\\n\\\n" default_consumer ${default_consumer})
configure_file(src/default_consumer.h.in default_consumer.h @ONLY)

add_executable(mkkeywordhash tool/mkkeywordhash.c)
target_compile_definitions(mkkeywordhash PRIVATE ${SQLITE_FLAGS})
add_custom_command(
  OUTPUT keywordhash.h
  DEPENDS mkkeywordhash
  COMMAND mkkeywordhash > keywordhash.h
)

find_program(tclsh NAMES tclsh8.6 tclsh8.5 tclsh)
if(NOT tclsh)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "tclsh not found!")
endif()
add_executable(lemon tool/lemon.c)
add_custom_command(
  OUTPUT parse.c parse.h
  DEPENDS lemon tool/lempar.c src/parse.y
  COMMAND lemon ${SQLITE_FLAGS} parse.y
)

# Generate sqlite3.h from src/sqlite.h.in rather than shipping it in the source
# tree. mksqlite3h.tcl stamps the header with the fossil source-id, which it
# gets by running mksourceid over the checked-in `manifest`.
add_executable(mksourceid tool/mksourceid.c)
add_custom_command(
  OUTPUT sqlite3.h
  DEPENDS
    mksourceid
    tool/mksqlite3h.tcl
    src/sqlite.h.in
    VERSION
    manifest
    manifest.tags
    manifest.uuid
    ext/rtree/sqlite3rtree.h
    ext/session/sqlite3session.h
    ext/fts5/fts5.h
  COMMAND ${tclsh} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tool/mksqlite3h.tcl
          ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} -o sqlite3.h
)
add_custom_target(generate_sqlite3_h
                  DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/sqlite3.h)

# Provide a CMake target, `sqlite3_header`, to support correct usage of the
# generated header: wait for the generate step to complete and add the header
# to the include path.
add_library(sqlite3_header INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(sqlite3_header INTERFACE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR})
add_dependencies(sqlite3_header generate_sqlite3_h)

add_custom_command(
  OUTPUT opcodes.c opcodes.h
  DEPENDS parse.h src/vdbe.c
  COMMAND cat parse.h ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/vdbe.c | ${tclsh} mkopcodeh.tcl > opcodes.h
  COMMAND sort -n -b -k 3 opcodes.h | ${tclsh} mkopcodec.tcl opcodes.h > opcodes.c
)
add_custom_command(
  OUTPUT pragma.h
  DEPENDS tool/mkpragmatab.tcl
  COMMAND ${tclsh} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tool/mkpragmatab.tcl pragma.h
)
add_custom_command(
  OUTPUT serialget.c memcompare.c vdbecompare.c vdbeaux.c
  DEPENDS parse.c src/vdbeaux.c
  COMMAND ${tclsh} mkvdbeauxinlines.tcl ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/vdbeaux.c .
)
